meta.title: Spanglish · Spanish lessons on the Sunshine Coast, in Brisbane and online
meta.description: Speak Spanish with confidence. Lessons with Maribel, a native and certified tutor, for adults, kids and mature learners on the Sunshine Coast, in Brisbane and online. Your first lesson is free.
meta.ogAlt: Spanglish logo: a yellow speech bubble with the letters ¡SPANGLISH!

hero.lead: Practical lessons with Maribel, a native and certified Spanish tutor. For adults, kids and mature learners on the Sunshine Coast, in Brisbane and online.
hero.free: Your first lesson is free: 45 minutes, online.
hero.chat2: ¡Genial! Let’s start with a free lesson.

lessons.question: Who are the lessons for?
lessons.intro: For anyone who wants to really speak Spanish, at any age. Pick your group and the format that suits you best.

adults.title: Adults
adults.body: Practical communication for everyday life, with clear grammar explanations.

kids.title: Kids
kids.body: Spanish for girls and boys aged 6 to 13.

mature.title: Mature adults
mature.body: A 10-lesson program designed for learners over 65.

online.title: Online conversations
online.body: A 10-week program to practise conversation from home.

private.title: Private 1-1
private.body: Online, at the tutor’s place or at a local library.

own.title: Your own group
own.body: With whoever you like, up to 2 people.

local.title: Local group
local.body: Learn with other people in your area.

how.question: What is a lesson like?
how.minutesNote: Plenty of time to talk, ask and practise.

practical.title: Practical communication
practical.body: The Spanish you use in real conversations.

summary.title: Summary and homework
summary.body: After each lesson you get a summary and homework.

how.places: Online, at local libraries, in offices or at home, on the Sunshine Coast and in Brisbane.

prices.question: How much does it cost?
prices.groupsAskBody: Ask us about dates and times for the upcoming groups.

maribel.question: Who is Maribel?
maribel.name: I’m Maribel
maribel.body: Maribel is a native, certified Spanish tutor. She lives in Australia and has more than 4 years of teaching experience.
maribel.body2: Her goal is that you speak Spanish confidently: practical communication, clear grammar, and a summary with homework after every lesson.

learn.question: Want to practise right now?
learn.body: Free interactive lessons, from the alphabet to verbs, via nouns and articles. For adults and kids, levels A1 to B2. Low-cost digital materials are available too.
learn.note: For now they live on the current Spanglish website.

contact.question: Shall we start?
contact.lead: Your first lesson is free: 45 minutes, online. Call or email us and we’ll book it.
contact.note: Very soon you’ll be able to book your lesson right here on this website.

footer.tagline: Our goal is that you speak Spanish confidently.
